$comment: Obot versions this provider supports. CI tests each entry and main; see README, 'Nightly compatibility tests'.
A series such as v0.27 means its newest stable patch release, found when CI runs; an exact tag such as v0.26.3 pins one release.
List the oldest supported series first. When the nightly run reports an unlisted Obot release, add its series here and remove series you stop supporting.
